name: Rigor Mortic
source: Starfinder Guilt of the Grave World

defensiveAbilities.name: Breaching Strikes
defensiveAbilities.description: A rigor mortic's melee Strikes treats the Hardness of all other creatures and objects as though they were 5 less than their normal value.

defensiveAbilities.name: Cocoon Projectile
defensiveAbilities.description: A fully-encased rigor mortic can be fired from a starship weapon into another vehicle or from a starship onto the ground. When delivered onto a battlefield in this fashion, the rigor mortic ignores all falling damage even if they're dropped from orbit. For 1 hour after a drop, a rigor mortic rolls initiative with a –2 penalty and is Stunned 1 for the first round of combat.

defensiveAbilities.name: Construct Armor
defensiveAbilities.description: A rigor mortic's grafted armor plates give it Hardness. This Hardness reduces any damage it takes by an amount equal to its Hardness. Once the rigor mortic is reduced to less than half its Hit Points, or immediately upon being damaged by a critical hit, its construct armor breaks, removing its Hardness and reducing its Armor Class to 12.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breaching Charge
offensiveAbilities.description: The rigor-mortic Strides twice and Strikes. If the Strike is a critical hit with a breaching weapon, the target is Stunned 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Construct Shield
offensiveAbilities.description: A rigor mortic can Raise a Shield using its integrated armor.

offensiveAbilities.name: Slow March
offensiveAbilities.description:
The rigor mortic Raises a Shield and Strides twice. The rigor mortic's allies within 20 feet gain lesser cover.

Effect: Cover
